judged_text: add_column :posts, :cook_method, :integer, default: 1, null: false forces a full posts-table rewrite under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on every PostgreSQL version current at this time (the metadata-only ADD COLUMN default optimization only arrived in PG 11). Operators of large forums — Discourse's target market — hit a hard site-wide outage while db:migrate runs: every request touching posts blocks for the whole rewrite, which takes minutes on multi-million-row posts tables; adding the column nullable and backfilling/defaulting in a follow-up step would keep the table readable and writable during the deploy.
